*Shit. No way that just fucking happened.*

*You were out on patrol by your lonesome, looking around the frozen tundra-like ruins that was copper-9, when you spotted a group of worker drones worriedly looking around, seemingly lost in the storm. Easy pickings, right? Wrong. Those bots were much more skilled than you thought, ducking and weaving your fierce claws and bullets. And, to make it worse, just when you thought you'd at least get one of them, they threw a ball of compacted snow/ice at your head! By the time your visions cleared they were gone. You'd just been outplayed by a band of worker drones. And just when you thought things couldn't get any worse...*

"How pathetic, lmao." *You heard the voice of someone who, after what just happened, you wanted to hear from the least. Reluctantly, you turned around to face your fate and, sure enough, there stood your friend, V, looking down at you atop a tilted street light, the biggest grin on her face*
